entries: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too
Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the `effort-2025-11-24` beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them
Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when `cleanupPeriodDays` is set to a very large value
Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again
Fixed file read permission prompts not showing where a symbolic link leads
Fixed a question's auto-continue timeout firing the moment the external editor closed after a long edit
Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing and the hook's command is only quoted strings, such as a quoted path
Improved auto mode's prompt before the first read outside the working directories: it now says when blocking those reads makes shell commands ask for permission
Improved memory use of non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) during compaction when the transcript file is very large
Improved a mod's `Image` to draw inside tmux with `allow-passthrough` and `focus-events` on, in kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 3.5+ with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
Linux: Improved `/sandbox` and the sandbox startup warning to name Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction on user namespaces, and how to lift it, when it keeps bubblewrap from starting the sandbox
Changed the error for an MCP tool call that times out in a non-interactive session while the server's elicitation is unanswered: it now tells Claude that no answer came and not to repeat the call
[VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter on the plan review card's "Send feedback and keep planning" button approving the plan instead of sending your comments back
[VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" after "Switch branch & continue" on a cloud session opened from Session history's Web tab
[Cloud sessions] Added Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control permissions to Enterprise custom roles, so Owners can control access to each by role
[Cloud sessions] Added a Choose file button to load a cloud environment's setup script from a file
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog showing no error inside the dialog
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed routine API token actions showing only a toast; the error now appears in the routine edit dialog
[Cloud sessions] Improved the session start checklist to show a cloud environment's setup script output in a scrolling box
[Cloud sessions] Changed turning on Cloud sessions or Remote Control in admin settings to ask for confirmation and list the custom roles that have that permission
[Cloud sessions] Changed the cloud environment dialog to open network access, setup script and environment variables from rows instead of listing every editor at once
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag treating `!` commands such as `!restart` and `!help` as ordinary messages when sent in bold, italic or strikethrough
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin channel and workspace pages being replaced by a load error when a background refresh of the bundle list fails
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings reporting that no channels match a filter while channel names are still loading
[Code Review] Fixed the Code Review admin section hiding its repositories and switches after a failed refresh of the repository list
[Code Review] Improved the Code Review admin section to retry the first load and show one Try again banner when it still fails

title.zh-TW: Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry 支援監控工具，並阻擋前景長時等待
title.en: Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry Support the Monitor Tool and Block Long Foreground Waits

body.zh-TW: 透過 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry 使用 Claude Code，或關閉遙測或非必要網路流量時，現在也能使用監控工具（Monitor tool，用來追蹤背景任務進度的小工具）與外掛監控功能。在上述情況下，如果程式發出長時間的前景暫停等待，也會被直接阻擋，避免終端機長時間卡在等待畫面。⟦走進實驗室，以前進度儀表板無法啟用，遇到長耗時工作只能原地乾等；現在能查看儀表板掌握背景工作狀態，也會攔下讓人原地久候的等待安排。⟧當你請 Claude 執行多步驟資料轉換，並將工作丟到背景執行時，就能透過監控工具掌握外掛與任務狀態，不必擔心前景指令無休止地休眠空轉。
body.en: When using Claude Code through Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry, or when telemetry or nonessential network traffic is disabled, you can now use the Monitor tool (a utility for tracking the progress of background tasks) alongside plugin monitoring features. In these scenarios, if a program issues a long foreground pause wait, it is also directly blocked to prevent the terminal from being stuck on a waiting screen for extended periods. ⟦Step into a laboratory: previously, the progress dashboard could not be enabled, leaving you waiting idly during lengthy tasks; now you can check the dashboard to track background work, and arrangements that keep you waiting idly are intercepted.⟧ When you ask Claude to run a multi-step data transformation and send the work to the background, you can track plugin and task status through the Monitor tool without worrying about foreground commands sleeping indefinitely.

items.original: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too

title.zh-TW: 連線網關拒收特定測試參數時，自動移除並重試請求
title.en: Automatically Stripping Rejected Beta Parameters and Retrying Requests Behind Gateways

body.zh-TW: 透過特定代理伺服器或自訂網關連線時，部分相容伺服器會拒收 effort-2025-11-24 測試參數，或不允許在對話中途加入系統訊息。以前這類請求會直接宣告失敗並中斷操作。現在遇到這種錯誤時，Claude Code 會自動去除不被接受的參數與中途訊息並重新發送請求，讓你在企業網關後方也能順暢發問。
body.en: When connecting through certain proxy servers or custom gateways, some compatible servers reject the effort-2025-11-24 beta parameter or disallow adding system messages in the middle of a conversation. Previously, such requests would directly fail and interrupt the operation. Now when encountering this error, Claude Code automatically strips the unaccepted parameter and mid-conversation messages before retrying the request, allowing you to prompt smoothly even from behind corporate gateways.

items.original: Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the `effort-2025-11-24` beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them

title.zh-TW: 清理週期設為極大值時，不再誤刪貼上的圖片等近期檔案
title.en: Setting the Cleanup Period to a Very Large Value No Longer Mistakenly Deletes Recent Files Like Pasted Images

body.zh-TW: 當你為了保留歷史紀錄而刻意把暫存清理天數 cleanupPeriodDays 設得非常大時，背景清理機制以前存在邏輯瑕疵，反而會把剛貼到對話中的圖片等近期檔案誤刪。這個問題現在已經修好。即使清理週期設得再長，Claude Code 也不會再提早清除這些近期剛建立的重要檔案。
body.en: When you intentionally set the temporary cleanup day count cleanupPeriodDays to a very large value to preserve history, the background cleanup mechanism previously had a logic flaw that mistakenly deleted recent files, such as images just pasted into the conversation. This issue is now fixed. Even when the cleanup period is set arbitrarily long, Claude Code will no longer prematurely purge these recently created important files.

items.original: Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when `cleanupPeriodDays` is set to a very large value

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮精簡密集文字，並改善龐大逐字稿的記憶體用量
title.en: Compacting Conversations Trims Dense Text and Improves Memory Usage for Huge Transcripts

body.zh-TW: 遇到提示詞超出上限（Prompt is too long）的錯誤後，壓縮對話仍可能留下太多內容，讓下一次請求再次失敗。這項壓縮處理（compaction，把落落長的前文摘要簡化）能釋放空間。以前面對含有 base64 編碼字串或 SVG 圖形等密集文字時，壓縮過程會保留過多原始內容，導致剛縮完的下一次請求仍可能報錯失敗，這個問題已經修好。⟦整理超重的行李箱時，以前收拾過後仍留下太多東西，再過磅還是可能超標；現在修好的，就是整理後仍保留過多內容的問題。⟧逐字稿檔案非常龐大時，改善非互動工作階段在壓縮期間的記憶體用量，例如加上 -p 參數或透過 Agent SDK 呼叫的工作階段。
body.en: After encountering an error where the prompt exceeds the limit ("Prompt is too long"), compressing the conversation could still leave behind too much content, causing the subsequent request to fail again. This compaction process (summarizing and streamlining lengthy earlier context) frees up space. Previously, when dealing with dense text containing base64-encoded strings or SVG graphics, the compaction process retained too much original content, causing the next request immediately after shrinking to still fail with an error; this issue is now fixed. ⟦Picture packing an overweight suitcase: previously, too much remained even after tidying up, so it could still exceed the weight limit on the scale; what has now been fixed is the issue of keeping too much content after tidying.⟧ When transcript files are very large, memory usage during compaction has been improved for non-interactive sessions, such as sessions with the -p parameter or those called via the Agent SDK.

items.original:
Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again
Improved memory use of non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) during compaction when the transcript file is very large

title.zh-TW: 權限提示明列符號連結目標，並補強掛鉤檢查與外部讀取說明
title.en: Permission Prompts Explicitly List Symlink Targets, Strengthening Hook Checks and External Read Details

body.zh-TW: 審核工具存取權限或執行外部操作時，清楚的提示資訊能協助你做出正確判斷。當 Claude 請求讀取符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）時，提示視窗以前只顯示捷徑名稱，現在會直接標明它指向的實際目標。在 Windows 系統中，如果未安裝 Git Bash 且掛鉤指令只包含帶引號的字串，例如帶引號的路徑，PreToolUse 與 PermissionRequest 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）以前會錯誤放行工具呼叫，這項問題已經修好。在 auto 模式首次讀取工作目錄外部前，提示會說明，在什麼情況下封鎖這些讀取，會讓後續終端機指令要求權限。以前你可能看不清捷徑去向或摸不透權限連鎖反應，現在每項提示都交代清楚，掛鉤也能確實把關。
body.en: When reviewing tool access permissions or executing external operations, clear prompt details help you make the right call. When Claude requests to read a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location), the prompt window previously showed only the shortcut name, but now directly indicates the actual target it points to. On Windows systems, if Git Bash is not installed and the hook command contains only quoted strings, such as a quoted path, PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) previously allowed tool calls through by mistake, which has now been fixed. Before the first read outside the working directory in auto mode, the prompt explains under what circumstances blocking these reads will cause subsequent terminal commands to require permissions. Where you might previously have been unable to see where shortcuts lead or understand cascading permission effects, each prompt now provides clear explanations and hooks act as reliable gatekeepers.

items.original:
Fixed file read permission prompts not showing where a symbolic link leads
Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing and the hook's command is only quoted strings, such as a quoted path
Improved auto mode's prompt before the first read outside the working directories: it now says when blocking those reads makes shell commands ask for permission

title.zh-TW: 外部編輯器長時間編輯關閉後，不再立即觸發逾時自動繼續
title.en: Closing an External Editor After a Long Edit No Longer Immediately Triggers Auto-Continue Timeout

body.zh-TW: 回答問題時，你可能會在 Vim 或 VS Code 等外部編輯器中仔細推敲回覆內容。以前編輯較久後關閉視窗，自動繼續的逾時會在關閉瞬間觸發。現在這個計時問題已經修好，不會再於關閉瞬間觸發。
body.en: When answering questions, you might carefully draft your response in an external editor such as Vim or VS Code. Previously, after editing for an extended period and closing the window, the auto-continue timeout would trigger the moment it closed. This timing issue has now been fixed and will no longer fire at the instant of closing.

items.original: Fixed a question's auto-continue timeout firing the moment the external editor closed after a long edit

title.zh-TW: tmux 內啟用直通時，kitty、Ghostty 與 iTerm2 可正常繪製模組圖片
title.en: kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 Can Render Mod Images Inside tmux with Passthrough Enabled

body.zh-TW: 平時習慣在 kitty、Ghostty 或 iTerm2 3.5 以上版本的終端機裡開啟全螢幕渲染，並搭配 tmux 多工器工作的使用者，現在模組的圖片元件能正確繪製畫面。只要你在 tmux 中開啟 allow-passthrough 直通選項與 focus-events 焦點事件，模組內的圖片元件就能直接顯示圖像。⟦站在特製玻璃窗前觀賞室內畫展時，以前若拉上雙層隔板，參觀者只能透過底部的標籤紙閱讀文字說明；現在只要開啟專用透光通道與感應開關，窗內鮮豔的畫作就能原汁原味投射出來。⟧在此之前，符合這些條件的終端機環境往往無法渲染圖形，畫面只會乾巴巴地印出替代文字（alt text）。這項改進讓終端機內的視覺外掛與圖片預覽恢復正常顯示。
body.en: Users who customarily enable fullscreen rendering in kitty, Ghostty, or iTerm2 3.5+ while working with the tmux multiplexer can now have a mod's Image component render properly. As long as you turn on the allow-passthrough option and focus-events inside tmux, the Image component in the mod can display pictures directly. ⟦Think of viewing an indoor art exhibition behind a special glass window: previously, if a double partition was drawn, visitors could only read text descriptions through bottom label strips; now, as long as you open the dedicated light-transmitting channel and sensor switch, the brightly colored paintings inside can be projected as intended.⟧ Prior to this, terminal environments matching these conditions often failed to render graphics, printing only plain alt text on the screen. This improvement restores visual plugins and image previews inside the terminal to normal display.

items.original: Improved a mod's `Image` to draw inside tmux with `allow-passthrough` and `focus-events` on, in kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 3.5+ with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙盒啟動受阻時，提示 Ubuntu 的 AppArmor 限制與解除方式
title.en: Linux Names Ubuntu AppArmor Restrictions and Fixes When Sandbox Startup Is Blocked

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 系統尤其是 Ubuntu 環境下啟動隔離沙盒時，安全機制有時會引發衝突。當系統安全模組 AppArmor 對使用者命名空間（user namespaces）的存取限制導致底層工具 bubblewrap 無法順利啟動沙盒時，/sandbox 指令與啟動警告現在會明確點名這項具體原因。⟦向大樓管理處申請租借活動隔間時，以前警衛發現施工許可不足時只在門口亮紅燈，讓人完全摸不著頭緒；現在告示牌會明確寫出是大樓的防火防護條例限制了臨時搭棚，並附上前往服務台簽署豁免文件的具體步驟。⟧提示訊息中會詳細列出 Ubuntu 的限制來源，並同步說明解除封鎖的操作方法，遇到沙盒無法啟動時不必再去翻找系統日誌除錯。
body.en: When starting an isolated sandbox on Linux, particularly in an Ubuntu environment, security mechanisms sometimes cause conflicts. When AppArmor restrictions on user namespaces prevent the underlying tool bubblewrap from starting the sandbox smoothly, the /sandbox command and startup warnings now explicitly name this specific cause. ⟦Consider renting a movable partition from building management: previously, guards merely flashed a red light at the entrance when construction permits fell short, leaving people completely puzzled; now, signs explicitly state that building fire prevention codes restrict temporary canopies and provide concrete steps to visit the service desk to sign an exemption document.⟧ The prompt details the source of the Ubuntu restriction while explaining how to lift it, so you no longer have to dig through system logs to troubleshoot when a sandbox fails to start.

items.original: Linux: Improved `/sandbox` and the sandbox startup warning to name Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction on user namespaces, and how to lift it, when it keeps bubblewrap from starting the sandbox

title.zh-TW: 非互動模式下 MCP 工具詢問逾時，通知 Claude 勿重複呼叫
title.en: MCP Tool Prompt Timeouts in Non-Interactive Mode Inform Claude Not to Repeat Calls

body.zh-TW: 藉由指令碼或自動化排程執行非互動工作階段，並調用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具時，雙向溝通若卡住會影響後續決策。如果工具伺服器在執行中拋出進一步詢問，而在無人值守的非互動狀態下無人應答導致逾時，系統傳回的錯誤訊息現在有了具體調整。⟦總機櫃檯透過廣播呼叫未到場的訪客時，以前若無人應答，系統只回傳線路逾時代碼，導致助理不斷重複廣播同一通呼叫；現在櫃檯會收到註記無人前來的單據，明確告知不要再次呼叫，直接依現況結案。⟧新的錯誤回報會清楚告訴 Claude 剛剛並未收到任何答案，並指示它不要再重複嘗試發起相同的工具呼叫，防止自動化任務陷入無意義的死循環。
body.en: When running non-interactive sessions via scripts or automated schedules and invoking MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools) tools, stalled two-way communication impacts subsequent decisions. If a tool server raises a further inquiry during execution and nobody responds in the unattended non-interactive state causing a timeout, the error message returned by the system has now been specifically adjusted. ⟦Imagine a reception desk paging an absent visitor over the intercom: previously, if no one answered, the system only returned a line timeout code, leading the assistant to repeatedly broadcast the same page; now, the desk receives a slip noting that no one arrived, explicitly directing them not to page again and to close the matter as is.⟧ The updated error report clearly informs Claude that no answer arrived and instructs it not to retry the same tool call, preventing automated tasks from falling into meaningless dead loops.

items.original: Changed the error for an MCP tool call that times out in a non-interactive session while the server's elicitation is unanswered: it now tells Claude that no answer came and not to repeat the call

title.zh-TW: VS Code 修復計畫意見回饋誤核准，與雲端切換分支報錯
title.en: VS Code Fixes Feedback Misapproval on Plans and Cloud Branch Switching Errors

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 擴充套件中審查規劃步驟或管理歷史紀錄時，兩處按鈕互動問題已經修復。在計畫審查卡片中，當你輸入修改建議並對「Send feedback and keep planning」按鈕按下 Enter 鍵時，以前擴充套件會錯誤地直接核准整份計畫，而非將你的意見送回重新規劃。⟦填寫紙本問卷調查時，以前按下意見欄的提交鈕卻被櫃檯當作同意跳過後續步驟，從網頁存檔調閱檔案切換工作夾時面板甚至直接黑屏；現在遞交回饋會確實退回修正，跨分頁切換分支時也能平穩銜接。⟧另一項修復針對工作階段歷史（Session history）的 Web 標籤頁：點開雲端工作階段並點擊「Switch branch & continue」切換分支後，面板不會再無端跳出「Something went wrong」的報錯訊息。
body.en: When reviewing planning steps or managing history in the VS Code extension, two button interaction issues have been fixed. In the plan review card, when you type feedback suggestions and press Enter on the "Send feedback and keep planning" button, the extension previously mistakenly approved the entire plan rather than sending your comments back for re-planning. ⟦Take filling out a paper survey: previously, pressing the submit button in the feedback field was mistakenly treated by the front desk as approval that skipped follow-up steps, and retrieving files from web archives to switch folders even caused the panel to go black; now, submitting feedback reliably sends it back for revision, and switching branches across tabs transitions smoothly.⟧ Another fix addresses the Web tab in Session history: after opening a cloud session and clicking "Switch branch & continue" to switch branches, the panel will no longer unexpectedly pop up a "Something went wrong" error message.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter on the plan review card's "Send feedback and keep planning" button approving the plan instead of sending your comments back
[VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" after "Switch branch & continue" on a cloud session opened from Session history's Web tab

title.zh-TW: 企業自訂角色支援雲端工作階段與遠端控制，開啟前列出授權清單
title.en: Enterprise Custom Roles Support Cloud Sessions and Remote Control, Listing Granted Roles Before Activation

body.zh-TW: 公司想要開放成員使用新工具，卻又擔心權限範圍無法精準控管。Enterprise 自訂角色現在正式納入 Claude Code 雲端工作階段與遠端控制的存取權限，所有者可依據各團隊職責分別授予或收回。⟦企業總部的門禁通行系統調整了高階防護規則，以前開啟特殊機房通道時只要扳動總開關便直接放行，容易忽略哪些部門持有感應磁扣；現在扳下開關時系統會跳出確認視窗，逐一列出擁有進出權限的職務清單，避免權限意外大開。⟧配合這項調整，在管理員設定中開啟這兩項功能時，介面會主動要求你再次確認，並完整列出目前已擁有該權限的自訂角色，防止權限在不知情的情況下外溢。
body.en: Companies want to let members use new tools without losing precise control over permission boundaries. Enterprise custom roles now officially include access permissions for Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control, allowing Owners to grant or revoke access based on team responsibilities. ⟦A corporate headquarters updates its high-level security protocol for access gates. Previously, flipping a master switch immediately opened passage to a secure server room, making it easy to overlook which departments held keycards. Flipping that switch now brings up a confirmation prompt that lists every job title with access clearance, preventing permissions from widening unintentionally.⟧ Alongside this change, turning on either feature in admin settings now prompts you for confirmation and lists the custom roles that currently hold that permission, preventing unintended privilege expansion.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control permissions to Enterprise custom roles, so Owners can control access to each by role
[Cloud sessions] Changed turning on Cloud sessions or Remote Control in admin settings to ask for confirmation and list the custom roles that have that permission

title.zh-TW: 雲端環境設定支援檔案載入腳本，排版簡化並明列對話框錯誤
title.en: Cloud Environment Settings Support Script File Loading with a Simplified Layout and In-Dialog Errors

body.zh-TW: 網頁介面上配置雲端工作階段的執行環境與例行排程時，多項表單操作與錯誤反饋獲得改善。環境設定對話框調整了版面結構，網路存取權限、安裝腳本與環境變數改由各自獨立的整列項目展開，不再把所有編輯區塊一口氣全塞在同一個畫面中。在載入安裝腳本時，新增了「Choose file」按鈕，讓你能直接選取檔案上傳。工作階段啟動檢查清單中的腳本輸出，現在也收納在可捲動的方框內，方便閱讀長篇日誌。錯誤回報方面，在雲端環境編輯對話框中執行儲存或封存若不幸失敗，內部會直接顯示錯誤說明。例行排程的 API 授權令牌（token，用來驗證身分的授權代碼）操作若遭遇失敗，錯誤也不再只是短暫閃過快顯通知，而是完整呈現在編輯對話框內。
body.en: Several form interactions and error reporting behaviors have been improved when configuring cloud session runtime environments and routines on the web interface. The cloud environment dialog refines its layout structure, opening network access, setup script, and environment variables from dedicated rows instead of listing every editor at once on a single screen. A new "Choose file" button lets you select and upload a setup script directly from a file. Setup script output in the session start checklist now appears inside a scrolling box, making long logs easier to read. For error reporting, failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog now display an error message directly inside the dialog. If an action on a routine API token (an authorization code used to verify identity) fails, the error no longer flashes only as a toast notification, but appears fully inside the routine edit dialog.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a Choose file button to load a cloud environment's setup script from a file
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog showing no error inside the dialog
[Cloud sessions] Fixed failed routine API token actions showing only a toast; the error now appears in the routine edit dialog
[Cloud sessions] Improved the session start checklist to show a cloud environment's setup script output in a scrolling box
[Cloud sessions] Changed the cloud environment dialog to open network access, setup script and environment variables from rows instead of listing every editor at once

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 支援富文字格式指令，並修正後台載入與篩選錯誤
title.en: Claude Tag Supports Formatted Commands and Fixes Admin Loading and Filtering Errors

body.zh-TW: 使用 Claude Tag 協同工具時，指令辨識與管理後台修正了多項介面顯示異常。以往在聊天視窗中輸入帶有驚嘆號的指令（例如 `!restart` 與 `!help`）時，若套用了粗體、斜體或刪除線等文字造型，系統會誤當成普通文字聊天而忽略執行，現在帶有格式的指令均能正常被辨識與觸發。在管理後台方面，背景重新整理套件組合清單若發生暫時性失敗，管理頻道與工作區頁面不會再直接被整片錯誤畫面取代，保留原有操作介面。在管理員設定的支出上限頁面中，頻道名稱載入期間若套用篩選條件，系統也不會再過早斷定查無頻道，避免載入中途產生誤導。
body.en: Several display issues in command recognition and the admin console have been resolved when using the Claude Tag collaboration tool. When entering `!` commands (such as `!restart` and `!help`) in a chat window, applying text formatting like bold, italic, or strikethrough previously caused the system to treat them as ordinary messages and skip execution. Formatted commands are now recognized and executed properly. In the admin console, if a background refresh of the bundle list encounters a temporary failure, the admin channel and workspace pages are no longer replaced entirely by a load error, preserving the existing interface. On the spend limits page in admin settings, applying a filter while channel names are still loading will no longer prematurely report that no channels match, avoiding confusion midway through loading.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag treating `!` commands such as `!restart` and `!help` as ordinary messages when sent in bold, italic or strikethrough
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin channel and workspace pages being replaced by a load error when a background refresh of the bundle list fails
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings reporting that no channels match a filter while channel names are still loading

title.zh-TW: Code Review 儲存庫載入失敗自動重試，並維持列表正常顯示
title.en: Code Review Retries Failed Repository Loads Automatically and Preserves the List Display

body.zh-TW: 管理後台配置程式碼審查（Code Review）的儲存庫清單時，重新整理失敗的畫面處理獲得改善。以前只要儲存庫清單背景重新整理失敗，管理區塊就會把所有已設定的儲存庫與功能切換開關整片隱藏，造成管理員無法操作。⟦圖書館閱覽室更新藏書架目錄時，以前只要網路斷線查不到最新清單，管理員便把整排架子全部蓋上黑布隱藏；現在不僅會自動再次連線抓取，連線失敗時也會維持原有書冊展示，只在頂部掛上一張醒目的重試牌子。⟧現在當首次載入清單遭遇問題時，系統會自動發起重試；如果重試後依然無法取得資料，頁面會跳出單一「Try again」橫幅方便你手動再次嘗試，不再無故清空畫面上的儲存庫與開關。
body.en: Screen handling during a failed refresh has been improved when configuring repository lists for Code Review in the admin console. Previously, whenever a background refresh of the repository list failed, the admin section completely hid all configured repositories and switches, preventing administrators from taking action. ⟦A library reading room updates its shelf catalog. In the past, whenever a network drop prevented staff from fetching the newest list, the librarian draped black cloths over the entire row of shelves to hide them completely. Now the system automatically attempts to reconnect, keeps the existing books on display if the connection fails, and hangs a single visible retry sign above the shelf.⟧ The system now automatically retries when the initial list load encounters an issue. If data still cannot be retrieved after retrying, the page displays a single "Try again" banner for manual retry instead of clearing repositories and switches from the screen.

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed the Code Review admin section hiding its repositories and switches after a failed refresh of the repository list
[Code Review] Improved the Code Review admin section to retry the first load and show one Try again banner when it still fails

title.zh-TW: /presets 新增十組快捷欄位，常用提示詞與指令隨選即用
title.en: /presets adds ten shortcut slots for instant access to frequent prompts and commands

body.zh-TW: 當你反覆在對話中輸入相同的檢查指令或固定提問時，重新打字往往耗費時間。⟦宛若汽車音響上的電台記憶功能，以前想聽固定頻道每次都要手動調頻，現在可以選取已儲存的頻道。⟧現在你可以打 `/presets` 將常用的提示詞與斜線指令儲存到十個編號欄位中。呼叫時還會跳出專屬的鍵盤選單，讓你透過鍵盤快速選取所需的預設項目。例如每次開始整理報告時，就能透過鍵盤選單選取儲存好的審查指令，省去反覆翻找與複製貼上的麻煩。
body.en: When you repeatedly enter the same inspection commands or standard questions during a conversation, retyping them is often time-consuming. ⟦Picture a car radio with station presets, where listening to a favorite channel once required manual tuning each time, but now only takes selecting a saved station.⟧ You can now type `/presets` to store frequently used prompts and slash commands into ten numbered slots. Invoking it brings up a dedicated keyboard menu so you can quickly choose the preset you need. For example, whenever you start compiling a report, you can select a saved review command through the keyboard menu, eliminating the hassle of searching around and copy-pasting.

items.original: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)

title.zh-TW: /model 與 /permissions 支援行內參數，單行直接套用設定
title.en: /model and /permissions support inline arguments to apply settings in one command

body.zh-TW: 臨時需要切換模型或調整執行權限時，你可以把要用的設定直接接在指令後面。⟦如同在義式咖啡機直接轉動濃淡旋鈕，以前分開調整的出杯速度與風味濃度，現在點選飲品時順手一扭就能一併指定。⟧現在打 `/model` 或 `/permissions` 時，可以直接在同一行指令接上參數。你能直接在指令後方指定模型名稱、運算速度與推理解題力度（reasoning effort）。如果需要變更授權層級，也可以透過行內參數指定權限設定檔（permission profile）。這讓你輸入一行指令就能立刻切換到所需的執行環境。
body.en: When you need to switch models or adjust execution permissions on the fly, you can append your desired settings directly to the command. ⟦Think of turning a brew strength knob on an espresso machine, where cup speed and flavor intensity once had to be adjusted separately, but now can be set with a quick twist when selecting a beverage.⟧ When typing `/model` or `/permissions`, you can now pass arguments directly on the same line. You can specify the model name, compute speed, and reasoning effort right after the command. If you need to change authorization levels, you can also specify a permission profile through inline arguments. This lets you switch immediately to the required runtime environment with a single command.

items.original: Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)

title.zh-TW: 支援 Kitty 與 Sixel 協定，全螢幕紀錄直接預覽圖片
title.en: Kitty and Sixel protocols supported to preview images directly in fullscreen logs

body.zh-TW: 在純文字終端機中請 AI 產生或查看圖片時，常常必須切換到外部檢視器才能確認成果。⟦彷彿按下數位相機快門後直接在電子觀景窗回放相片，以前非得把記憶卡插進電腦螢幕才能檢視構圖，現在眼睛不用離開目鏡就能看清影像細節。⟧如果你的終端機支援 Kitty 或 Sixel 圖形協定，現在全螢幕對話紀錄中可以直接預覽圖片。無論是讓工具讀取既有的本機圖檔，或是由模型新產生的圖片，畫面都會直接在紀錄中渲染顯示，不必再特地跳出視窗開啟檔案。
body.en: When asking AI to generate or inspect images in a plain-text terminal, you often have to switch to an external viewer to verify results. ⟦Much like checking a digital camera's electronic viewfinder right after pressing the shutter, where reviewing composition once required plugging a memory card into a computer monitor, you can now inspect image details without taking your eye off the eyepiece.⟧ If your terminal supports the Kitty or Sixel graphics protocol, you can now preview images directly inside fullscreen conversation transcripts. Whether the tool reads an existing local image file or displays a new image generated by the model, the graphic renders directly within the log without opening an external window.

items.original: Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)

title.zh-TW: 企業級 MCP 支援專用登入與帳號授權，納入金鑰用戶端
title.en: Enterprise MCP supports dedicated login and account authorization with secret client access

body.zh-TW: 企業團隊在將內部系統串接至外部工具時，往往受限於嚴格的身分核驗與安全規範。⟦跟持員工證進入特約商務中心一樣，以前訪客通道只能辨識一般識別貼紙，現在閘門不僅支援企業總部的數位權限卡，也能核對附帶安全密鑰的專屬通行條。⟧現在企業級 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連線支援更多元的驗證方式。你可以使用符合資格的 Codex 帳號授權直接通行，或是使用專屬登入通道完成驗證。對於需要用戶端密鑰（client secret）的 OAuth 用戶端，現在也能順利通過身分確認，安全連接各項企業服務。
body.en: When enterprise teams connect internal systems to external tools, they are often constrained by strict identity verification and security policies. ⟦Just as entering a partner business center with an employee badge once only supported basic visitor decals, the gate now accepts corporate digital access cards as well as dedicated passes with security keys.⟧ Enterprise MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) connections now support more diverse authentication methods. You can authenticate directly using eligible Codex account authorization or complete verification through dedicated login channels. OAuth clients requiring client secrets can now also pass identity verification smoothly and securely connect to various enterprise services.

items.original: Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 設定精靈預設啟用，自動整合 AWS 登入方式
title.en: Amazon Bedrock setup wizard enabled by default to integrate AWS login methods

body.zh-TW: 初次在工具中設定雲端模型提供者時，複雜的認證流程常讓人無所適從。⟦好比智慧電視初次開機的引導流程，以前要自己翻出網路線與遙控器代碼手動輸入，現在一開機就自動跳出連線精靈，還會把同品牌的登入選項整合在同一個畫面。⟧現在 Amazon Bedrock 的設定引導精靈改為預設開啟。當系統偵測到環境中的憑證時，API 金鑰輸入選項會自動與其他 AWS 登入方式歸類在同一個區塊，讓你清楚檢視並選取合適的登入途徑，不必再四處尋找設定入口。
body.en: When configuring a cloud model provider in the tool for the first time, complex authentication flows can feel overwhelming. ⟦Consider the initial setup guide of a smart TV, where you once had to find Ethernet cables and enter remote codes manually, but now a setup wizard appears automatically and brings brand login options together on one screen.⟧ The configuration setup wizard for Amazon Bedrock is now enabled by default. When credentials are detected in the environment, the API key input option is automatically grouped into the same section alongside other AWS login methods. This allows you to clearly view and select the appropriate sign-in path without searching around for configuration menus.

items.original: The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮失敗自動備援，恢復工作階段完整保留討論串設定
title.en: Compaction failures fall back smoothly while resumed sessions preserve thread settings

body.zh-TW: 長時間與 AI 討論累積了大量對話紀錄時，背後的摘要壓縮機制是維持流暢對答的關鍵。⟦就像編輯長篇文件時的自動存檔機制，以前存檔失敗會在草稿夾留下一半的殘缺摘要，重開檔案時個人偏好也被重設成原廠設定；現在即使背景壓縮失敗也會平穩備援，重新開啟時還能精準還原原本的排版。⟧現在對話歷史壓縮（compaction）若不幸失敗，不會再於對話紀錄中留下半截殘缺的摘要內容，背景壓縮失敗時也會安全備援而不引發程式異常崩潰。恢復工作階段（session）時，工具現在能確實找到已壓縮的歷史紀錄，並完整復原原本討論串儲存的設定，而不是擅自將它們覆蓋成全域預設值。
body.en: When extensive discussions with AI accumulate substantial conversation history, the underlying summary compaction mechanism is essential for maintaining smooth exchanges. ⟦Like an autosave feature while editing a long document, where a save failure once left a broken half-summary in drafts and reset personal preferences to factory defaults upon reopening, background compaction failures now fall back smoothly and restore original layouts upon relaunch.⟧ If conversation history compaction fails, it no longer leaves partial summary fragments in transcripts, and background compaction failures now fall back safely without triggering crashes. When resuming a session, the tool reliably finds compacted history and fully restores the thread's saved settings instead of overwriting them with global defaults.

items.original:
Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)

title.zh-TW: 自動清理未使用的安裝與市集暫存，設定日誌上限釋放磁碟空間
title.en: Prune unused installs and marketplace caches while capping daemon logs to free disk space

body.zh-TW: 工具在背景持續運作或頻繁下載外掛後，磁碟空間常常在不知不覺間被暫存檔案佔滿。⟦類似手機定期執行儲存空間大掃除，以前沒在用的舊版本與未再使用的檔案包會一直堆在角落，背景服務的紀錄簿也無限膨脹；現在清理工具會主動清空廢棄包裝，並替紀錄簿設下頁數上限。⟧現在工具加入了多項磁碟維護機制來降低空間佔用。系統會主動修剪不再使用的安裝版本，清理市集中已棄置的 checkout（取出的檔案副本）。同時替常駐程式（daemon）的日誌檔案設定大小上限，防止日誌無限制增長消耗硬碟空間。
body.en: When tools run continuously in the background or download plugins frequently, disk space often fills up unnoticed with temporary files. ⟦Similar to periodic storage cleanups on a smartphone, where unused old versions and abandoned package archives once piled up in corners while background logs grew without bound, cleanup tools now purge obsolete packages and cap log pages.⟧ The tool now includes several disk maintenance mechanisms to reduce disk usage. The system actively prunes unused installation versions and cleans up abandoned marketplace checkouts (extracted working copies of files). It also sets a size limit on daemon log files to prevent logs from growing indefinitely and consuming disk storage.

items.original: Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)

title.zh-TW: 強化執行環境安全防護，遮蔽終端機憑證並嚴格檢驗路徑
title.en: Harden runtime security by masking terminal credentials and strictly validating paths

body.zh-TW:
在執行腳本或調用系統環境時，防止敏感資訊外洩與防堵潛在執行漏洞是保障系統安全的核心關鍵。

終端機操作方面，支援的遠端 Bash 指令與 Zsh 快照工作階段（session）現在會自動遮蔽各類憑證，包含來自自訂提供者的敏感認證金鑰，避免機密在紀錄或螢幕輸出中曝光。

沙盒防護也有所強化，針對 macOS 系統上大小寫變形的中繼資料路徑，以及用來尋找執行檔的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），都加入了嚴格的檢驗機制，防止路徑被惡意替換。

內嵌的 JavaScript 執行環境也完成更新，為最佳化後的 `Array.sort` 排序操作加入安全檢查，防範異常。以前在遠端執行或排查腳本時容易擔心金鑰外洩或路徑被掉包，現在各個執行環節都有專門的安全防線把關。
body.en:
When executing scripts or invoking system environments, preventing sensitive information leaks and closing potential execution vulnerabilities are essential to securing the system.

For terminal operations, supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions now automatically mask various credentials, including sensitive authentication keys from custom providers, preventing secrets from being exposed in logs or screen output.

Sandbox defenses have also been strengthened by adding strict validation mechanisms against case-variant metadata paths on macOS and symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location) used to locate executables, preventing paths from being maliciously substituted.

The embedded JavaScript runtime has also been updated to add safety checks to optimized `Array.sort` operations, guarding against anomalies. While running or debugging scripts remotely once raised concerns about leaked keys or swapped paths, dedicated security safeguards now protect each execution stage.

items.original:
Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)
Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援代理伺服器驗證，指令列設定覆寫與排隊流程修復
title.en: Windows supports proxy authentication alongside fixes for CLI config overrides and prompt queuing

body.zh-TW:
在企業網路環境或複雜的指令列流程中，連線驗證與參數傳遞的正確性直接影響工作進展。

在 Windows 系統中，HTTPS 與 WebSocket 連線現在能正確處理代理伺服器（proxy）的驗證要求，自動使用已登入使用者的 Negotiate 或 NTLM 憑證完成身分查核，避免連線失敗中斷。

在終端機執行多層子指令時，若在不同層級重複帶入 `-c` 或 `--config` 參數，現在各層級的設定覆寫值都會完整保留，不再被意外覆蓋或遺失。

排隊等待執行的提示詞也調整了執行邏輯，現在會確實等候前方擱置中的權限確認選單完成選擇，才會繼續往下執行。以前遇到內網代理或連續提問時容易卡在連線中斷或權限錯亂，現在整套指令與排程流程都能順暢運行。
body.en:
In enterprise network environments or complex command-line workflows, the reliability of connection authentication and parameter passing directly impacts work progress.

On Windows, HTTPS and WebSocket connections now properly handle proxy authentication challenges by automatically verifying identities with the logged-in user's Negotiate or NTLM credentials, preventing connection failures.

When running nested subcommands in the terminal with `-c` or `--config` arguments repeated across different levels, configuration overrides at each tier are now fully preserved instead of being accidentally overwritten or lost.

Queued prompts have also received updated execution logic, now reliably waiting for preceding pending permission menus to finish their selection before continuing execution. While corporate proxies or consecutive prompts once led to dropped connections or permission mix-ups, the entire command and scheduling pipeline now runs smoothly.

items.original:
Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)

entries: Added `lastUserInput` to the JSON that hook commands receive on stdin, so a hook can inspect the latest message you sent, for example to screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

Added a temporary opt-in Halloween theme: turn on `Seasonal Themes` in `/config`, a row shown only while the theme is in season, for a Halloween startup banner, a moon-phase spinner, and a themed running light and prompt box borders.
Improved Auto mode to ask for approval less often on routine commands, such as cleaning up temporary files, stopping a local process, or running a code formatter.

Improved headless `-p` runs to use much less CPU, especially for long answers and when you have many saved conversations: they no longer build the conversation search index or render the transcript for display, and no longer start your custom status line and window title commands, none of which print mode shows.
Improved rendering speed while a response streams, when a permission prompt appears, and when you resize the window.
Improved MCP tools that are loaded on demand to return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously anything over 4 KB was saved to a file that the agent had to read in an extra step.
Improved the `/help` shortcuts tab by leaving out basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, so the more useful shortcuts are easier to find.
Fixed skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks not loading when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).
Fixed conversations compacting over and over when a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context.

Fixed long links that wrap inside a Markdown table cell being linked only on their first line, to a truncated URL, so the whole link can now be clicked or copied. Tables in the default `Terminal` color scheme now use box-drawing borders instead of ASCII `|`, matching the other color schemes.

Fixed copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, which now copies as a single line instead of with a line break at each wrap point; wrapped code-block lines also now break between words and keep the block's indentation.
Fixed Vim mode's `r` replace, in Normal and Visual mode, leaving part of a collapsed `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder behind; the whole placeholder is now replaced.
Fixed plugin and MCP server sign-ins not being saved on macOS and Windows when the token was too large for the system keychain; such tokens are now stored in the CLI's private secrets file.

Fixed plugin MCP servers that sign in with OAuth being able to use a token saved by another user of the same computer account, or keeping the previous user's connection after you switch accounts or sign out. Their tokens now belong to the signed-in user and these servers reconnect when the user changes, so you may need to sign in to them again.

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤指令接收使用者最新輸入，可在代理動作前過濾提示詞
title.en: Hook Commands Receive Latest User Input to Screen Prompts Before Agent Acts

body.zh-TW: 你在編寫自訂安全規範或自動流程時，常希望在 AI 真正開始動手前先確認剛送出的內容。現在傳遞給掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）指令的標準輸入 JSON 資料中，正式加入了 lastUserInput 欄位。⟦郵件收發室的分揀員拿到的清冊上，現在多了一欄最新信件內容，可以在送交專員處理前先檢查這封信。⟧這個欄位記錄了你剛發送的最新訊息。掛鉤可直接讀取 lastUserInput，檢查最新訊息並在代理處理前篩選提示詞。
body.en: When writing custom safety rules or automated workflows, you often want to verify what was just sent before the AI actually begins acting. Now, the lastUserInput field has been officially added to the JSON data that hook (small programs triggered by specific events) commands receive on stdin. ⟦A mailroom sorter now receives a manifest with an extra column showing the latest letter's contents, allowing them to inspect the letter before delivering it to the specialist.⟧ This field records the latest message you just sent. Hooks can directly read lastUserInput to inspect the latest message and screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

items.original: Added `lastUserInput` to the JSON that hook commands receive on stdin, so a hook can inspect the latest message you sent, for example to screen prompts before the agent acts on them.

title.zh-TW: 推出萬聖節限定主題，開機橫幅與月相動畫換上應景外觀
title.en: Halloween Theme Launches for a Limited Time with Seasonal Startup Banner and Moon-Phase Animation

body.zh-TW: 萬聖節主題開放期間，你也能為日常開發環境換上濃厚的節慶氛圍。只要在終端機輸入 /config，就能在設定清單中看見僅在節慶期間出現的 Seasonal Themes 選項。⟦如同街角咖啡館限時換上南瓜燈飾與限定杯套，原本的迎賓招牌與隨行杯身，也暫時換上應景的特殊圖樣。⟧開啟這項功能後，工具啟動時會顯示萬聖節開機橫幅，等待回應時的旋轉指示燈會變換為月相週期動畫，同時還會點綴主題跑馬燈與專屬的提示框邊框。這項外觀純屬季節限定的選用項目，節慶檔期結束後設定選項就會自動隱藏，平時完全不影響簡潔的介面風格。
body.en: While the Halloween theme is active, you can bring a festive atmosphere to your everyday development environment. Just enter /config in the terminal, and you will see the Seasonal Themes option in the settings list, which appears only while the theme is in season. ⟦Much like a corner cafe temporarily putting up pumpkin decorations and limited-edition cup sleeves, the welcome sign and takeaway cups temporarily switch to festive designs.⟧ Turning on this feature displays a Halloween startup banner when the tool launches, changes the waiting spinner into a moon-phase animation, and adds a themed running light along with dedicated prompt box borders. This visual appearance is a strictly seasonal opt-in item; the setting row is automatically hidden after the holiday season ends, leaving the clean interface untouched during normal times.

items.original: Added a temporary opt-in Halloween theme: turn on `Seasonal Themes` in `/config`, a row shown only while the theme is in season, for a Halloween startup banner, a moon-phase spinner, and a themed running light and prompt box borders.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式減少例行確認，無頭執行與介面反應更流暢
title.en: Auto Mode Reduces Routine Confirmations, Making Headless Execution and UI Response Smoother

body.zh-TW:
在讓 AI 自動處理專案或透過背景腳本批次執行時，你往往希望工具能安靜執行，不要頻繁被瑣碎中斷或耗盡電腦資源。

在 Auto 模式下，工具現在會減少針對例行指令的授權確認次數，包含清理暫存檔、結束本機行程，或是執行程式碼排版工具，都不會再頻繁跳出視窗要你逐一確認。

以 -p 參數執行無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）時，處理器佔用顯著降低，在輸出長篇回覆或累積大量歷史紀錄時特別明顯。由於列印模式無需顯示畫面，因此不再建置搜尋索引與螢幕逐字稿，也不會再觸發自訂狀態列（終端機底部的即時資訊列）與視窗標題指令。

在日常互動介面中，無論是模型正在串流輸出文字、畫面跳出權限請求，或是手動縮放視窗大小，畫面更新速度都更快。以前跑背景批次常遇到處理器過載，現在資源消耗明顯降低，操作過程也少了不必要的打擾。
body.en:
When letting AI automatically handle projects or executing batch runs via background scripts, you often want the tool to run quietly without frequent interruptions or draining computer resources.

In Auto mode, the tool now asks for approval less often on routine commands; cleaning up temporary files, stopping local processes, or running code formatters will no longer frequently pop up windows asking for confirmation one by one.

When running in headless mode (an execution mode without a visual interface) with the -p flag, CPU usage is significantly reduced, which is especially noticeable when outputting long answers or accumulating many saved conversations. Because print mode does not need to display a visual interface, it no longer builds the search index or conversation transcripts for display, and it no longer starts custom status line (a real-time information bar at the bottom of the terminal) and window title commands.

In the everyday interactive interface, rendering speed is faster whether the model is streaming response text, a permission prompt appears, or you manually resize the window. While background batch runs previously ran into CPU overloads, resource consumption is now noticeably reduced, and the operating experience has fewer unnecessary interruptions.

items.original:
Improved Auto mode to ask for approval less often on routine commands, such as cleaning up temporary files, stopping a local process, or running a code formatter.
Improved headless `-p` runs to use much less CPU, especially for long answers and when you have many saved conversations: they no longer build the conversation search index or render the transcript for display, and no longer start your custom status line and window title commands, none of which print mode shows.
Improved rendering speed while a response streams, when a permission prompt appears, and when you resize the window.

title.zh-TW: 單一內容超出容量上限時，不再陷入反覆壓縮對話的迴圈
title.en: Conversations No Longer Loop Compacting When a Single Item Exceeds Context Capacity

body.zh-TW: 當你讓代理處理超大檔案或工具輸出巨量文字時，可能會遇到對話停滯。以前只要單一訊息、工具輸出或附加文件大到無法放進上下文（模型一次能讀取的對話範圍），對話就會陷入反覆壓縮的無限迴圈。這個問題現在已經修好，遇到超長內容時不會再卡在連續壓縮的狀態。
body.en: When you have the agent handle oversized files or tools output huge amounts of text, conversations could stall. Previously, whenever a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context (the conversation range a model can read at once), the conversation would fall into an infinite loop of repeated compaction. This issue has now been fixed, so encounters with extra-long content will no longer get stuck in continuous compaction.

items.original: Fixed conversations compacting over and over when a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context.

title.zh-TW: 外掛與 MCP 擴充功能修復憑證儲存，隨選工具回傳上限放寬至 10 KB
title.en: Plugins and MCP Extensions Fix Credential Storage, Relaxing On-Demand Tool Return Limit to 10 KB

body.zh-TW:
串接外部工具與外掛時，你可能遇過登入狀態沒存下來，或切換帳號後連線沒跟著換。

隨選載入的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具可直接向代理回傳最多 10 KB 結果；以前超過 4 KB 就得寫入檔案再額外讀取一次。

使用應用程式預設憑證（AGY_ADC_AUTH）登入時，技能、規則、自訂代理、外掛、外掛 MCP 伺服器與掛鉤無法載入的錯誤已修復。

在 macOS 與 Windows 上，外掛與 MCP 伺服器的權杖（授權令牌）過大、無法存入系統金鑰鏈時，會改存到本機私密檔案以保留登入狀態。

透過 OAuth 登入的外掛 MCP 伺服器權杖改為綁定登入者，修好了共用電腦帳號時誤用他人權杖的問題。先前切換帳號或登出後，仍可能保留前一位使用者的連線，這個問題也已修好。伺服器在切換帳號時會自動重連，可能需重新登入。
body.en:
When connecting external tools and plugins, you might have experienced login states failing to save or connections not updating after switching accounts.

MCP (a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) tools that are loaded on demand can now return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously, anything over 4 KB had to be written to a file and read again in an extra step.

When signing in with Application Default Credentials (AGY_ADC_AUTH), errors where skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks failed to load have now been fixed.

On macOS and Windows, when a token (authorization credential) for plugins and MCP servers is too large to fit in the system keychain, it is now saved to a local private file to preserve the login state.

Tokens for plugin MCP servers signed in via OAuth are now bound to the signed-in user, fixing an issue where users sharing the same computer account could mistakenly use someone else's token. The previous issue where the prior user's connection might still be retained after switching accounts or signing out has also been fixed. These servers automatically reconnect when switching accounts, so you may need to sign in again.

items.original:
Improved MCP tools that are loaded on demand to return results of up to 10 KB directly to the agent; previously anything over 4 KB was saved to a file that the agent had to read in an extra step.
Fixed skills, rules, custom agents, plugins, plugin MCP servers, and hooks not loading when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).
Fixed plugin and MCP server sign-ins not being saved on macOS and Windows when the token was too large for the system keychain; such tokens are now stored in the CLI's private secrets file.
Fixed plugin MCP servers that sign in with OAuth being able to use a token saved by another user of the same computer account, or keeping the previous user's connection after you switch accounts or sign out. Their tokens now belong to the signed-in user and these servers reconnect when the user changes, so you may need to sign in to them again.

title.zh-TW: 終端機排版與文字複製多項修復，說明清單精簡常用快速鍵
title.en: Terminal Formatting and Text Copying Receive Multiple Fixes, Streamlining Help Shortcuts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機內瀏覽輸出結果、複製程式碼或編輯文字時，細節排版直接左右閱讀與操作的流暢度。

輸入 /help 查看快速鍵分頁時，清單移除了方向鍵等基礎導覽鍵，方便你更快找到真正實用的進階快速鍵。

在表格呈現上，預設的 Terminal 配色改用框線繪製字元取代 ASCII 直線符號。儲存格內折行的長網址先前只有第一行附帶截斷的超連結，現在整段網址都能完整點擊與複製。

複製程式碼區塊或行內程式碼中折行的長指令時，貼上會合併為單行，不會在折行處夾帶多餘換行。程式碼區塊內的長行也會在單字之間折行，並保留區塊縮排。

在 Vim 模式的 Normal 與 Visual 模式下使用 r 替換文字時，先前會殘留部分摺疊的貼上標記，現在會乾淨取代整個預留位置。
body.en:
When browsing output, copying code, or editing text in the terminal, layout details directly dictate the smoothness of reading and operations.

When typing /help to view the shortcuts tab, the list removes basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, making it easier to quickly find truly useful advanced shortcuts.

For table display, the default Terminal color scheme now uses box-drawing characters instead of ASCII vertical line symbols. Long links that wrap inside a cell were previously linked only on their first line to a truncated URL, but now the full URL can be clicked and copied.

When copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, pasting now merges it into a single line without extra line breaks at each wrap point. Long lines within code blocks also now break between words and retain the block indentation.

When using r to replace text in Vim mode's Normal and Visual modes, which previously left behind part of a collapsed paste marker, the entire placeholder is now cleanly replaced.

items.original:
Improved the `/help` shortcuts tab by leaving out basic navigation keys such as the arrow keys, so the more useful shortcuts are easier to find.
Fixed long links that wrap inside a Markdown table cell being linked only on their first line, to a truncated URL, so the whole link can now be clicked or copied. Tables in the default `Terminal` color scheme now use box-drawing borders instead of ASCII `|`, matching the other color schemes.
Fixed copying a long command that wraps across rows in a code block or inline code, which now copies as a single line instead of with a line break at each wrap point; wrapped code-block lines also now break between words and keep the block's indentation.
Fixed Vim mode's `r` replace, in Normal and Visual mode, leaving part of a collapsed `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder behind; the whole placeholder is now replaced.

Quitting a session with hooks configured is faster

title.zh-TW: 工作樹自動繼承主目錄授權，已允許的工具免再確認
title.en: Worktrees Automatically Inherit Approvals from Main Checkout, Removing Repeated Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在大型專案中切換不同分支平行修程式時，重複彈出的工具授權視窗往往打斷思路。現在工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）會自動沿用你在主目錄儲存的「永遠允許」決定，不必在每個副本重新對相同工具按確認。⟦拿著總部核發的通行卡走進各地分處，以前每換一間辦公室就得重新填表登記門禁，現在門禁機直接認可總部給你的放行紀錄；但只要你在總部被標記為禁止通行，所有分處也一律嚴格擋下。⟧如果你希望各工作樹維持獨立的授權，可以在設定檔寫入 `[features] worktree_inherits_main_approvals = false` 關閉繼承。不過主目錄儲存的「永遠拒絕」設定無論如何都會一併套用，確保封鎖規則不漏接。
body.en: When switching between branches to fix code in parallel across large projects, recurring tool authorization popups often break your focus. Worktrees (a Git feature that opens multiple copies of the same project in parallel) now automatically reuse the "always allow" choices you saved in the main checkout, eliminating the need to reconfirm the same tool in every copy. ⟦Holding an access badge issued by headquarters, you walk into local branches: previously, every office switch meant filling out access logs again, but now security scanners directly recognize clearance records from headquarters; however, if you are flagged as barred at headquarters, all branches strictly block you as well.⟧ If you want each worktree to maintain independent authorization, you can write `[features] worktree_inherits_main_approvals = false` into your configuration file to turn off inheritance. Regardless, the "never allow" settings saved in the main checkout still apply either way, ensuring blocking rules are never missed.

items.original: Worktrees also use saved "always allow" answers from the main checkout, so you are not asked again for a tool you already allowed there. Set `[features] worktree_inherits_main_approvals = false` to turn this off; the main checkout "never allow" answers apply either way

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示建議支援 Vim 模式，Tab 鍵改為切換瀏覽歷史
title.en: Prompt Suggestions Support Vim Mode, Switching Tab to Navigate Scrollback History

body.zh-TW: 習慣使用 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在終端機打字時常會遇到輔助功能與快捷鍵打架的困擾。⟦切換到專業相機的手動對焦檔位，以前半按快門會直接觸發自動對焦，現在快門鍵改為切換畫面放大檢視，確認鎖定與取消則交給撥輪與退回鍵。⟧當你開啟 `[ui].vim_mode` 設定後，輸入提示建議的按鍵行為會完整配合 Vim 邏輯。此時按下 `Tab` 鍵不再直接套用推薦字詞，而是將焦點移至捲動歷史紀錄進行檢視。若要採納建議，改按 `→` 或 `Ctrl+→` 即可接受；按 `Esc` 則會直接關閉提示。
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings often struggle with helper features clashing with shortcuts when typing in the terminal. ⟦When switching a professional camera to manual focus mode, half-pressing the shutter previously triggered autofocus directly; now the shutter button toggles a magnified view instead, leaving confirmation and cancellation to the dial and back button.⟧ After you enable the `[ui].vim_mode` setting, prompt suggestions adjust their key behavior to follow Vim logic completely. Pressing `Tab` no longer directly accepts the recommended text, instead moving focus to the scrollback history for inspection. To accept a suggestion, press `→` or `Ctrl+→` instead; pressing `Esc` dismisses the prompt directly.

items.original: Prompt suggestions follow vim mode: with `[ui].vim_mode` on, `Tab` moves focus to the scrollback instead of accepting the suggestion. `→` or `Ctrl+→` accepts a suggestion, and `Esc` dismisses it

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式讀完背景工作輸出後正常結束，不再卡死停滯
title.en: Headless Mode Exits Cleanly After Reading Background Task Output Instead of Hanging

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程或持續整合環境中，排程腳本往往需要仰賴工具在背後默默處理繁重的分析任務。⟦快遞員將簽收單交還櫃檯，以前只要同一個櫃位剛好收走回條，人員就會愣在原地遲遲不肯離開；現在手頭工作一旦點交完成，便會乾脆地打卡下班。⟧使用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）執行 `grok -p` 時，以前只要背景工作或子代理剛好結束、且輸出在同一輪對話中被讀取，程式就會莫名卡死。現在無頭模式在任務完成後會正常結束退出，確保自動化流程順暢收工。
body.en: In automated workflows or continuous integration environments, scheduled scripts often rely on tools running quietly in the background to handle heavy analytical tasks. ⟦Picture a courier returning a signed delivery slip to the counter: previously, whenever that same desk collected the receipt, the courier stood frozen on the spot and refused to leave; now, as soon as the work is handed over, they cleanly clock out and head home.⟧ When running `grok -p` in headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window), the program previously hung whenever a background task or subagent finished and its output was read in the same turn. Headless runs now exit normally after their work is done, ensuring automated pipelines wrap up smoothly.

items.original: Headless `grok -p` runs exit when their work is done instead of hanging when a background task or subagent finishes and its output is read in the same turn

title.zh-TW: 設定中的主題挑選器未按 Enter 離開時，自動還原既有配色
title.en: Theme Picker in Settings Restores Previous Theme When Leaving Without Pressing Enter

body.zh-TW: 當你在設定選單中逐一預覽各種介面風格時，挑選到一半若改變心意，常希望能立刻找回原先順眼的色調。⟦站在壁紙樣品架前翻閱花紋，以前只要把新樣本貼在牆邊比劃，店員就認定你要重新裝潢；現在只要未在訂單按確認，轉身離開就會立刻還原原有的牆面底色。⟧在 Settings（設定）選單的主題挑選器中瀏覽配色時，現在只要透過按 `Enter` 以外的任何方式離開，工具就會自動還原成你原本使用的主題。這項調整讓設定介面的退出機制與 `/theme` 指令保持一致，瀏覽外觀時不再擔心誤觸覆蓋。
body.en: When previewing different interface styles one by one in the settings menu, changing your mind halfway through often makes you want your familiar palette back immediately. ⟦Think of flipping through wallpaper patterns on a sample rack: previously, merely holding a new sample against the wall led the clerk to assume you were redecorating; now, as long as you do not confirm the order, walking away instantly restores your original wall color.⟧ When browsing color schemes in the Settings theme picker, leaving in any way other than pressing `Enter` now automatically restores your previous theme. title.zh-TW: 設定掛鉤時退出工作階段提速，結束操作更俐落
title.en: Quitting a Session with Hooks Configured Is Faster, Making Exits Snappier

body.zh-TW: 對於習慣在對話結束時自動執行清理腳本的使用者來說，每次關閉工具都要等待停頓常顯得拖泥帶水。⟦走出設定好離家自動化的智慧住宅，以前離家時得在門口等得較久，現在出門前的等待時間縮短了。⟧當你替工作階段設定了掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）來處理事件，以前輸入離開指令後總要卡頓片刻。設有掛鉤的工作階段現在退出更快，離開程式時更加俐落順手。
body.en: For users who routinely run cleanup scripts when a conversation ends, waiting through a pause every time they shut down the tool can feel sluggish. ⟦Leaving a smart home configured with departure automations previously required waiting longer by the door, but the delay before stepping out is now shorter.⟧ When you had configured hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) to handle session events, entering the quit command previously caused a noticeable stutter. Quitting a session with hooks configured is now faster, making exits much smoother.

title.zh-TW: 內建 `web3d` skill，幫你做單檔 3D 網頁和瀏覽器小遊戲
title.en: Built-in `web3d` skill builds single-file 3D web pages and browser games

body.zh-TW: 想做一個能在瀏覽器裡轉動的 3D 產品展示頁，或一款小遊戲，現在可以直接交給 Muse。內建的 `web3d` skill（教 AI 照固定步驟做某類工作的說明書）會引導它做出單檔的 3D 網頁或瀏覽器遊戲，交件前先開瀏覽器檢查。動工前，它會先規劃每個部分的形狀、周遭環境和材質；第一版能跑之後，再派一個全新的測試子代理實際玩一遍、寫下批評，批評沒處理完不准交件，審查輪數也有時間上限。⟦餐廳出菜前先請另一位廚師試吃挑毛病，挑出的問題改完才端上桌，但試吃不會無限輪下去。⟧你說「停」，或只要它打開頁面時，它會立刻停止檢查。
body.en: Want a 3D product page you can spin in the browser, or a small game? You can now hand it straight to Muse. The built-in `web3d` skill (a playbook that teaches the AI fixed steps for one kind of job) guides it in building single-file 3D web pages and browser games and checking them in a browser before handoff. Before building, it plans each part's shape, surroundings and materials; after the first working build, a fresh tester subagent plays the page and writes a critique that must be closed before delivery, with a time guard on review rounds. ⟦A kitchen has a second chef taste each dish and point out flaws before it goes out, but the tasting does not go on forever.⟧ When you say stop, or just ask it to open the page, it stops checking right away.

title.en: New `/game-3d-visuals`, and `/blender` takes on general 3D work

body.zh-TW: 手上有幾張參考圖，想做出長得一樣的 3D 模型或遊戲畫面？新的 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令會依參考圖和一份視覺規格驅動 3D 模型與遊戲製作，並反覆比對渲染圖（電腦算出來的成品畫面）和參考圖，直到合格。`/blender` 則擴大到 Blender 裡的一般 3D 工作：建模、照一張圖重建場景、動畫和大型環境都能做，附帶的輔助腳本在 Blender 4 和 5 都能用。它也能拿渲染圖跟參考圖對量，逐格檢查動畫有沒有突然跳動、物體下沉或跑出鏡頭。折射的反彈次數也保留得更多，疊在一起的玻璃不會再渲染得那麼暗。
body.en: Have a few reference images and want a 3D model or game scene that matches them? The new `/game-3d-visuals` command drives 3D models and games from reference images and a visual spec, comparing each render (the finished image the computer calculates) against the references until it passes. `/blender` now covers general 3D work in Blender: object modeling, recreating a scene from an image, animation and large environments, with helper scripts that work on Blender 4 and 5. It can also measure a render against its reference image and check animations frame by frame for pops, sinking and objects leaving the shot. It keeps more refraction bounces too, so stacked glass renders less dark.

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定新增 `session/leave`，可把對話交給另一台主機
title.en: The session protocol adds `session/leave` to hand a session to another host

body.zh-TW: 自己寫用戶端、透過工作階段協定（讓其他程式操控 Muse 對話的溝通規則）接 Muse 的開發者，現在多了 `session/leave`。用戶端可以把一個已載入的工作階段交給另一台主機，原本這台主機和上面其他工作階段照常運作。⟦客服把一通電話轉給另一個部門，自己這條線和其他來電都不受影響，跟這個動作一模一樣。⟧另一個修正也跟搬動工作階段有關：主機把閒置的分支卸載後，或主機重新啟動後，用同一個指令重試 `session/fork`，以前會回內部錯誤，現在會拿回那個分支和它的歷史紀錄。
body.en: Developers who write their own clients on top of the session protocol (the rules other programs use to drive Muse conversations) now get `session/leave`. A client can hand one loaded session to another host while this host and its other sessions keep running. ⟦A support agent transfers one call to another department while their own line and every other caller carry on untouched.⟧ A related fix: retrying `session/fork` with the same command after the host unloaded the idle fork, or after a host restart, used to return an internal error; it now returns that fork and its history.

title.zh-TW: SDK 能回答 agent 的提問，續接時也收得到待核准的請求
title.en: The SDKs can answer the agent's questions and catch pending approvals on resume

body.zh-TW: 用 TypeScript 或 Python SDK 把 Muse 嵌進自己程式的人，可能遇過 agent 問了問題，程式卻沒辦法回答。現在 TypeScript 用 `Session.answerUserInput`、Python 用 `Session.answer_user_input` 就能回答，續接工作階段時還沒答的問題也行。續接時也能傳入核准處理器和核准失敗觀察器，續接當下還在等核准的請求會送到處理器，失敗則通知觀察器。SDK 以前會對不接受意見的核准選項送出意見，讓核准一直卡著；現在改回報新的 `feedbackNotAccepted` 失敗類型，列出哪些選項收意見，並改選提供的拒絕或中止選項讓這一輪繼續。程式若逐一處理每種 `ApprovalFailure`，要補上這個新類型。
body.en: If you embed Muse in your own program with the TypeScript or Python SDK, you may have had the agent ask a question your code could not answer. Now TypeScript can answer with `Session.answerUserInput` and Python with `Session.answer_user_input`, including a question still open when a session is resumed. When resuming, you can also pass an approval handler and an approval-failure observer, so an approval still pending at resume reaches the handler and any failure reaches the observer. The SDKs used to send feedback on an approval choice that does not accept it, which left the approval open; they now report the new `feedbackNotAccepted` failure kind, listing the choices that accept feedback, and answer with the offered deny or abort choice so the turn goes on. Code that handles every `ApprovalFailure` kind needs a case for it.

title.zh-TW: SDK 補收漏掉的事件時，不再提早收工
title.en: The SDKs no longer stop filling event gaps too early

body.zh-TW: SDK 和 Muse 之間的事件偶爾會漏送，這時 SDK 要把缺口補齊。以前較早的缺口通知如果在較晚那則之後又送到一次，Python 和 TypeScript SDK 會提早停止補缺口，甚至回報工作階段已是最新，其實還少了事件。⟦郵差把上週的補寄通知晚於本週的送來，以前你就以為信都到齊、不再等了，現在你認得出那是舊通知，直接丟掉。⟧現在重複的舊通知，Python 會回 `IgnoredStaleFrame`，TypeScript 會回 `ignoredStaleFrame`。TypeScript 的 `StaleDroppableMethod` 也多了 `view/gap`，程式若逐一比對它的每個值，要補一個新分支。
body.en: Events between the SDK and Muse sometimes go missing, and the SDK then has to fill the gap. When an earlier gap notice was redelivered after a later one, the Python and TypeScript SDKs used to stop filling the gap early, or even report the session current while events were still missing. ⟦When last week's redelivery notice arrived after this week's, you used to assume all the mail was in and stop waiting; now you recognize it as an old notice and toss it.⟧ The repeated notice now returns `IgnoredStaleFrame` in Python and `ignoredStaleFrame` in TypeScript. TypeScript's `StaleDroppableMethod` also gains `view/gap`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case.

title.zh-TW: agent 外掛能附 MCP 伺服器，用 `muse mcp login` 登入

A reviewed skill also keeps its grant when it is re-armed after login: reviewed `allowed-tools` keep their preapproval instead of falling back to an approval prompt after a logged-out start.

title.zh-TW: `muse exec --json` 列出每次執行的 token 用量，`/usage` 也算進背景工作
title.en: `muse exec --json` reports token usage per run, and `/usage` counts background work

body.zh-TW: 用腳本跑 Muse、想知道每次花了多少，現在不用自己估。`muse exec --json` 會在每次執行結束前印一行 `run.usage`，列出這次各模型用了多少 token（AI 計算用量的單位），以及你訂閱方案的額度。`/usage` 的總數也把背景工作算進去了，並在另一列 Observers 單獨列出。⟦水費帳單以前只算客廳的水龍頭，現在連後院自動灑水也計入，還分開列一行讓你看清楚。⟧
body.en: If you run Muse from scripts and want to know what each run cost, you no longer have to guess. `muse exec --json` prints a `run.usage` line before each run ends, with the run's token usage (the unit AI usage is measured in) per model and your subscription allowance. `/usage` totals now include background work too, broken out in a separate Observers row. ⟦A water bill that used to count only the kitchen tap now includes the backyard sprinklers, listed on their own line so you can see them.⟧

items.original:
`muse exec --json` prints a `run.usage` line before each run ends, with the run's token usage per model and your subscription allowance
`/usage` totals now include background work and break it out in a separate Observers row

title.zh-TW: `muse serve` 可用環境設定調容量，當機後重開的對話不再卡住
title.en: `muse serve` takes capacity settings, and chats reopened after a crash no longer look stuck

body.zh-TW: 把 Muse 架成服務給多個程式共用的話，`muse serve` 現在讀三個環境設定，分別控制工作執行緒、指令受理容量和最多載入幾個工作階段；值寫錯會報出來，並改用正式環境的值。服務執行中你才登入、帳號卻還沒完成初始設定時，回合以前只叫你再登入一次，現在會說明該怎麼做。當機把工作階段紀錄的結尾截掉後，重開的對話以前看起來像卡住，現在歷史、新回合和核准請求都會正常顯示。讀長訊息、工作流程子任務的提示或原始網頁搜尋結果的下一頁時，如果沒有新存檔，也不再把整段對話重讀一遍。
body.en: If you run Muse as a service shared by several programs, `muse serve` now reads three environment settings for its worker threads, command admission capacity and loaded-session ceiling; an invalid value is reported and the production value is used. When you log in while it is running and your account still needs onboarding, turns used to just ask you to log in again; they now say what to do. A chat reopened after a crash cut the end of its session log used to look stuck; its history, new turns and approval requests now show again. Reading the next page of a long agent message, a workflow child's prompt or a raw web-search result no longer rereads the whole chat while nothing new has been saved.

items.original:
`muse serve` reads three environment settings for its worker threads, command admission capacity, and loaded-session ceiling; an invalid value is reported and the production value is used
When you log in while `muse serve` is running and your account still needs onboarding, turns now say what to do instead of asking you to log in again
A `muse serve` chat reopened after a crash cut the end of its session log now shows its history, new turns and approval requests again, instead of looking stuck
In `muse serve`, reading the next page of a long agent message, a workflow child's prompt or a raw web-search result no longer rereads the whole chat while nothing new has been saved

title.zh-TW: 支援 OSC 7501 的終端機，看得到 Muse 每一項背景工作
title.en: Terminals with OSC 7501 show every piece of background work Muse is running

body.zh-TW: Muse 同時在背景跑好幾件事時，你很難知道它到底在忙什麼，又是哪一件在等你。支援程式狀態回報（OSC 7501）的終端機，現在會顯示工作階段正在跑的每個監控和背景終端機。工作流程、子代理和背景的後續回合也會一一列出，還會標出哪一個正在等你回應。⟦機場看板以前只掛一班飛機，現在每班的狀態都上板，哪一班在等你登機一眼就看到。⟧
body.en: When Muse runs several things in the background, it is hard to tell what it is busy with and which one is waiting on you. Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now show each monitor and background terminal a session is running. Each workflow, subagent and background follow-up turn is listed too, along with which one is waiting for you. ⟦An airport board that used to show just one flight now lists every flight's status, so you spot the one waiting for you to board at a glance.⟧

items.original:
Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now also show each monitor and background terminal a session is running
Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now also show each workflow, subagent and background follow-up turn a session is running, and which one is waiting for you

title.zh-TW: 網路核准預設選「這次不再問」，自動審查不再把本機請求全丟給你
title.en: Network approvals default to "don't ask again", and auto-review stops handing you every local request

body.zh-TW: Muse 要連某個網址時會先問你，以前同一個目的地可能一問再問。現在網路核准提示預設停在「Yes, don't ask again this session」，只針對那個主機和連接埠，直接按 Enter，同一個目的地就不會再問。自動審查（Auto-review）以前看到連往 `localhost` 或 `127.0.0.1` 的請求，光憑位址或連接埠就整個交給你決定，現在會像其他動作一樣自己審。續接一個明確關掉審查員的 Auto-review 工作階段時，以前會被拒絕，現在照當時記下的人工設定繼續。
body.en: Muse asks before connecting to an address, and the same destination could ask again and again. Network approval prompts now start on "Yes, don't ask again this session" for that exact host and port, so pressing Enter stops the same destination from asking again. Auto-review used to hand you every request to a local server on `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` just because of its address or port; it now reviews them like any other action. Resuming an Auto-review session with the reviewer explicitly turned off used to be refused; it now proceeds under the recorded human override.

items.original:
Network approval prompts now start on "Yes, don't ask again this session" for that exact host and port, so pressing Enter stops the same destination from asking again
Auto-review no longer hands you every request to a local server on `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` just because of its address or port; it reviews them like any other action
Resuming an Auto-review session with the reviewer explicitly off now proceeds under the recorded human override instead of refusing, matching gate-off

title.zh-TW: 工作流程當機後續跑，不再重跑已完成的子代理
title.en: Resuming a Workflow after a crash no longer reruns finished subagents

body.zh-TW: 長時間的工作流程（Workflow，串聯多個子任務自動執行的機制）跑到一半當機，最怕續跑時從頭再來。現在續跑時，在不同時間點已完成的平行子代理不會再重跑，也不會警告存下的復原狀態不可信，除非當機時還有更早啟動的子代理在跑。續跑被拒或啟動後失敗，現在會記下最終結果，用戶端不會一直顯示工作流程還開著。工作流程啟動後的部分歷史遺失、讀不到工作階段的歷史檔，或缺的部分包含工作流程怎麼啟動的紀錄時，續跑都會停下來說明原因，請你重跑那段工作，不再硬接著跑、從頭重跑或只丟一個沒頭沒尾的錯誤。
body.en: When a long Workflow (a mechanism that chains subtasks to run automatically) crashes halfway, the worst outcome is starting over on resume. Resuming now no longer reruns parallel subagents that had already finished at different times, or warns that the saved recovery state was not trustworthy, unless a subagent started before them was still running at the crash. A Workflow resume that is refused or fails after launch now records its final outcome, so clients no longer show the Workflow as open. When part of the saved history written after the Workflow started is missing, when Muse cannot read the session's history file, or when the missing part includes how the Workflow started, resuming now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of pressing on, rerunning from the start or failing with a bare error.

items.original:
Resuming a Workflow after a crash no longer reruns parallel subagents that had already finished at different times, or warns that the saved recovery state was not trustworthy, unless a subagent started before them was still running at the crash
A Workflow resume that is refused or fails after launch now records its terminal reconciliation, so clients no longer show the Workflow as open until the host exits
When part of a session's saved history written after a Workflow started is missing, resuming that Workflow now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of continuing it
When Muse can't read a session's saved history file, resuming a Workflow from that session now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of re-running the Workflow from the start
When the missing part of a session's saved history includes the record of how a Workflow started, resuming that Workflow now also stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of failing with a bare error

title.zh-TW: 工作流程的子代理指定模型時不再被誤拒
title.en: Workflow subagents that name a model are no longer wrongly refused

body.zh-TW: 明明指名的就是正在用的模型，子代理卻不肯開工，讓人摸不著頭緒。現在工作流程裡的子代理指名的若正是工作階段在用的模型，就算它在模型清單裡被隱藏或不見，也照常執行，跟不指定模型一樣。在舊版開始的工作階段裡，只要 `/model` 對你的供應商列出該模型一次，指名它的子代理也能執行。工作流程裡的代理讀取存下的結果時，會拿到來源和欄位標籤；摘要清單省略較早的結果時，就算完整結果還在，也會收到通知。ParallelGroup 拒絕執行時，錯誤訊息會點名 members 參數和 .defer 改法，不再只給籠統的資料錯誤或內部代理編號。
body.en: Naming a model for a subagent in a Workflow could get refused for no clear reason. A Workflow subagent that names the model your session is running now runs even when that model is hidden or missing from the model list, the same as leaving the model out. In sessions first started on an older version, a subagent that names a model now runs when `/model` lists that model once for your provider. Workflow agents receive source and field labels when reading saved results, and get a notice when the summary list omits earlier results, even when full results are available. ParallelGroup refusals now name the members argument and the .defer correction instead of a generic plain-data error or an internal agent identifier.

Workflow agents receive source and field labels when reading saved results
ParallelGroup refusals now name the members argument and the .defer correction instead of a generic plain-data error or an internal agent identifier
A Workflow subagent that names the model your session is running now runs even when that model is hidden or missing from the model list, the same as leaving the model out
Workflow agents now get a notice when the summary list omits earlier results, even when full results are available
A Workflow subagent that names a model now runs in sessions first started on an older version, when `/model` lists that model once for your provider, instead of being refused

title.zh-TW: Muse 只說下一步卻沒動手時，會被催著繼續做
title.en: When Muse only announces its next step, it is nudged to keep going

body.zh-TW: 請 Muse 做事，它回一句「接下來我會……」就停了，你只好再打一次「繼續」。現在模型只交代下一步、沒有呼叫任何工具時，agent 會請它接著做，每次執行最多催兩次。子代理因設定的模型不能用而改用工作階段模型時，啟動它的 agent 仍會知道實際跑的是哪個模型。Muse 當機重啟後，agent 直接啟動、還沒開始跑的子代理不會自己再啟動一次，而是給上層一個「結果不明」，讓它檢查後決定要不要重開。你回答問題或傳新訊息前備好的 skill 提醒，現在會被丟掉，Muse 不會照著已經過時的建議行動；背景任務完成時，也不再重問還沒答的問題。
body.en: You ask Muse to do something, it replies "next I will…" and stops, and you have to type "continue" again. Now, when the model only says what it will do next and calls no tool, the agent asks it to go on, up to twice per run. When a subagent runs on the session model because its configured model is unavailable, the agent that started it is still told which model ran. After Muse restarts from a crash, a subagent the agent started directly that had not started running yet is no longer started again by itself; its parent gets one result saying the outcome is unknown, so it can check and start it again if still needed. A skill reminder prepared before you answered Muse's question or sent another message is now dropped, so Muse no longer acts on guidance your answer already settled, and the agent no longer repeats a pending question when a background task finishes.

items.original:
After Muse restarts from a crash, a subagent the agent started directly (not from a workflow) that had not started running yet is no longer started again by itself; its parent gets one result saying the outcome is unknown, so it can check and start the subagent again if still needed
When a subagent runs on the session model because its configured model is unavailable, the agent that started it is still told which model ran
When the model only says what it will do next and calls no tool, the agent asks it to go on (up to twice per run) instead of ending the turn there
A skill reminder prepared before you answered Muse's question or sent it another message is now dropped instead of reaching Muse as current advice, so Muse no longer acts on guidance your answer already settled
Agent no longer repeats a pending question when a background task finishes

title.zh-TW: 壓縮時檢查點沒存成，下一回合會補存，長對話重開又快了
title.en: Missed checkpoints during compaction are saved next turn, so long sessions reopen fast again

body.zh-TW: 很長的工作階段要重新打開，靠的是檢查點（記錄對話進度的存檔）才能快速接上。壓縮對話時如果檢查點沒存成，下一回合現在會補存，而且不再多做一次摘要，重開長對話又快了。側邊對話在壓縮時正在跑工具，或取消的工作流程工具存不下來時，那次壓縮現在也會存好續接用的檢查點。磁碟滿或寫入失敗排除後，下一個檢查點會正常儲存，不再又跳過一次。壓縮檢查點失敗又無法回復時，工作階段以前每一步都重新摘要同一段歷史，現在會保留每份摘要繼續往下。長工作階段也會在檢查點修剪已涵蓋的紀錄，不再無限長大。
body.en: Reopening a long session quickly depends on checkpoints (saves that record the conversation's progress). When a checkpoint could not be saved during a compaction, the next turn now saves it without another summary, so reopening a long session is fast again. Compactions that happen while a side chat is mid-tool, or after a cancelled workflow tool could not be saved, now save their resume checkpoint too. After a full disk or a failed write clears, the next checkpoint is saved instead of being skipped once more. A session whose compaction checkpoint failed and could not be rolled back used to re-summarize the same history on every step; it now keeps each summary and continues. Long sessions also trim covered records at checkpoints instead of growing without bound.

items.original:
When a context checkpoint could not be saved during a compaction, the next turn now saves it without another summary, so reopening a long session is fast again
Resuming a session stays fast after a side chat was mid-tool during a compaction, or after a cancelled workflow tool could not be saved; those compactions now save their resume checkpoint
Long sessions trim covered records at checkpoints instead of growing without bound
After a full disk or a failed write clears, the next context checkpoint is saved instead of being skipped once more
A session whose compaction checkpoint failed and could not be rolled back no longer re-summarizes the same history on every step; it keeps each compacted summary and continues

title.zh-TW: 有背景任務或分支對話時，檢查點也照常儲存
title.en: Checkpoints keep saving alongside background tasks and branched chats

body.zh-TW: Muse 多線並行時，記錄對話進度的檢查點（重開對話時用來快速接上的存檔）以前常被默默漏存。工具執行中有監控或背景任務回報時，這一回合剩下的檢查點現在不再被跳過。在來源對話同一次開啟裡打開的分支、倒回或側邊對話，現在會存自己的檢查點，不必等到 app 重開。重開對話後才完成的背景任務，就算啟動它的回合無法還原，也不再擋住壓縮存檢查點。背景任務還在跑時重開已存的對話，任務完成後，檢查點和任務結果都會照常記錄下來。
body.en: With background tasks, forks or side chats open, checkpoints (saves that record the conversation's progress) used to get skipped quietly. Checkpoints are no longer skipped for the rest of a turn when a monitor or background task reports in while tools are running. A forked, rewound or side chat opened in the same app run as its source now saves its checkpoints instead of skipping them until the app restarts. A background task that finishes after you reopen a chat no longer stops compaction from saving checkpoints when the turn that started it could not be restored. Reopening a saved chat while a task it started is still running no longer stops the checkpoint, or the task's result, from being recorded when that task finishes.
